messages:
emily: quick heads-up: canary for multi-tenant-gateway stalled in us-east; deploy-bot reports values drift. Canary paused.
deploy-bot: preflight failed: values-drift-detected. live values checksum != release values checksum. Affected keys: tenants.*.rateLimit, ingress.annotations.tls. Suggest manual reconcile or pin live values via annotation `release.redwood.io/live-values-pin=<hash>`.
rafael: which tenants flagged? tenant-a, tenant-b (edgezone), tenant-c (staging-promote). Note: tenant-a intentionally has a custom rateLimit that we must not overwrite.
nina: we can't blindly overwrite tenant-a. Options: (A) pin chart to previous stable and delay rollout, (B) selectively reconcile non-tenant keys and preserve tenant overrides.
emily: I prefer selective reconcile so we don't block the entire rollout. We can patch the HelmRelease to allowlist safe keys and skip tenant.*.
release-manager: agree but we need release notes calling out preserved tenant overrides and a security approval.
infra-oncall: deploy-bot supports an allowlist annotation. Commands to apply:
```
kubectl -n prod annotate helmrelease multi-tenant-gateway \
  release.redwood.io/values-override-allowlist="ingress.annotations.tls,global.featureX" --overwrite
kubectl -n prod annotate helmrelease multi-tenant-gateway \
  release.redwood.io/live-values-pin="sha256:1234abcd" --overwrite
```
rafael: will this prevent auto-rollback flapping? if mismatches persist we should pin previous revision to avoid flip-flop.
deploy-bot: annotation applied. Canary resumed with allowlist. Monitoring window 45m. Incident record created: values-drift-1768888888.
nina: applying a canary-only patch to skip tenant rate limit changes:
```
helm upgrade --install multi-tenant-gateway ./charts/gateway \
  --set global.applyTenantRateLimit=false --namespace prod --reuse-values
```
emily: new canary pods are up, health checks green at 3m.
security: please add an audit entry noting tenant-a rate limit preserved and authorizeor: emily. We need this in the compliance trail.
release-manager: adding release-note: "Canary resumed with selective values reconcile; tenant-specific rate limits preserved for tenant-a per ops request. Rollback plan: `helm rollback multi-tenant-gateway <prev-rev>` and clear annotations with `kubectl annotate helmrelease multi-tenant-gateway release.redwood.io/live-values-pin-` if needed."
rafael: opened follow-up RDW-678 to add values parity checks in CI and require explicit approval for tenant-scoped key changes.
infra-oncall: after 45m monitor, canary metrics stable. If no regressions, we'll unlock auto-promotion. To unblock: `kubectl annotate helmrelease multi-tenant-gateway release.redwood.io/promotion-block=false --overwrite`.
emily: thanks all. Pushing final changelog line and tagging release v2.4.0-rc1. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: incident closed. Reminder: to revert pin run `kubectl annotate helmrelease multi-tenant-gateway release.redwood.io/live-values-pin=false --overwrite` and then `deploy-bot promote --chart multi-tenant-gateway --rev latest` once RDW-678 is cleared."
